points.description: States that piggybacking requires two-way communication, i.e. a full-duplex or half/semi-duplex connection (data flowing in both directions between sender and receiver), or that frames carry an extra acknowledgement field so ACKs can ride on data frames.
points.partial_credit: Half marks if only vaguely on track, e.g. says both sides send data or mentions acknowledgements attached to data frames without stating the two-way requirement.

rubric.notes: Full marks for saying the connection must be two-way (full- or semi-duplex), or that data frames need a field for acknowledgements; either wording of the central idea is enough. Part marks for vague answers such as 'both sides must send data' or 'ACK sent with data' without clearly giving the requirement. No marks for unrelated answers, e.g. one-way only transmission.
